verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents RESTful APIs and a PowerShell module covering core directory services, cross-OS device management, onboarding/offboarding workflows, directory event export, and bulk operations across users, devices, and groups. Its API 2.0 spec also exposes graph-traversal endpoints. Nothing in the pack claims or demonstrates that every UI action has an API equivalent, so parity is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage of features like SSO/MFA/RADIUS/password vault/conditional access configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: JumpCloud makes it possible to operate core directory services, support cross-OS device management, establish automatic onboarding and offboarding workflows, and manage and export your directory events data through RESTful commands.
Through APIs or our PowerShell module, operate at scale by performing bulk operations across users, devices, and groups
Specific GET endpoints will allow you to traverse the JumpCloud Graph to return all indirect and directly bound objects in your organization.
